name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage explorer developing its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta province of Argentina. Diablillos hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with Measured & Indicated resources of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold. The company is advancing toward a Definitive Feasibility Study and construction decision for Diablillos.
